failure.version_missing: there is no such version in the history
failure.unknown_transaction: the daemon does not know an apply with this id
failure.nothing_to_confirm: there is nothing to confirm: the confirmation window is closed
failure.config_modified: the config file was changed outside metabox
failure.config_too_large: the config is larger than allowed
failure.device_invalid: the daemon rejected the device name
failure.dataplane_invalid: the traffic interception settings in UCI contain errors
failure.dataplane_modified: the traffic interception settings changed on the device, the list was reloaded
failure.dataplane_foreign_service: traffic interception is configured only for the metabox-singbox service, and the panel manages a different one
failure.log_unavailable: the sing-box log is unavailable: logread did not respond or the log file could not be opened
failure.log_query_invalid: the daemon rejected the log level or line count
failure.log_stream_limit: too many log streams are open — close extra tabs
failure.log_clear_forbidden: the log file is outside the config directory, /var/run and /tmp — the daemon does not clear it
failure.list_invalid: the daemon rejected the list file
failure.workdir_mismatch: the sing-box service working directory does not match the config directory
failure.launch_mismatch: the sing-box service does not run on the config the panel manages
